name: audio-tools.setpoint-read
purpose: Read bounded engine, health, and selected experiment measurements without promoting diagnostic or replay evidence into voice acceptance.

experiment_id.description: Optional explicit experiment ID (ASCII letters, digits, hyphen, underscore; at most 128 characters). No automatic latest-run selection.

assumptions: Run through the Program Runtime lab instance when collecting owner qualification evidence: product composition intentionally omits lab-only experiment routes, so a product-instance evidence read returns a binding error and partial status.
The accepted portable-voice target and the adopted outcome inventory in TESTING.md and MONETIZATION.md define the current bands; reporting a band does not mean its evidence passed.
Experiment metrics are diagnostic replay readings, not current browser latency, native-device qualification, or billing evidence.
Protojson omits some zero/default scalar fields; absent values remain unknown rather than being imputed as zero.
invariants: No audio, transcript, credential, raw provider error, inference request, or mutation appears in output or is initiated by this program.

Portable-voice-v1 target rows are resolved only by the owner-backed acceptance receipt join. Generic qualification evidence is never accepted merely because it exists; excluded rows remain explicitly excluded. Target text summarizes the accepted numerical, corpus, and billing policy; status ok only means collection succeeded.
Each binding failure is isolated and reported; no missing read becomes a zero or a passing band. Malformed, failed, and empty owner receipts remain visible as negative evidence.
Engine and health inventories use a sentinel above their bounds; oversized inventories are declined, never silently truncated into exact counts.
A selected experiment must match identity and have succeeded before exposing its bounded replay metrics; zero reference words, missing metrics, and nonfinite values are not quality evidence.
The program prints one standard JSON envelope on every path.

bindings.note: Owner-backed transcript-free qualification receipts; empty or failed receipts never qualify a row.
Only called for an explicit experiment_id; meta contains experiment and report, not run rows.

signals.acceptance: unknown until every required row is resolved by the owner-backed receipt join; excluded rows are explicit.
signals.rows: Twenty {row,reading,target,in_band,unavailable,reason} outcome rows, one per published PRD target in PRD order. Exact row-to-target mapping: dictation-trust=OT-P0-001; provider-parity=OT-P0-002; speaker-policy=OT-P0-003; explicit-routing=OT-P0-004; interactive-latency=OT-P0-005; corpus-quality=OT-P0-006; owned-settlement=OT-P0-007; host-portability=OT-P0-008; private-lifecycle=OT-P0-009; acceptance-integrity=OT-P0-010; desktop-dictation-parity=OT-P0-011; provider-evidence=OT-P1-001; mobile-recovery=OT-P1-002; adapter-maintainability=OT-P1-003; shared-voice-capabilities=OT-P1-004; efficient-model-selection=OT-P1-005; advanced-voice-workflows=OT-P1-006; standalone-offer-upgrade=OT-P1-007; offline-install-lifecycle=OT-P1-008; device-qualification=OT-P2-001. Required readings contain matching cohort/build and receipt references only after strict revision and negative-control checks; excluded rows remain explicit. The efficient-model-selection row may show a bounded observation-only D1/D2 model-resolution receipt, but remains unknown until matching quality, capacity, and route/fallback evidence passes. Use row identity, not list position or a cached row count.
signals.model_resolution: Latest valid target-aware D1/D2 model-resolution observation and matching model-memory subreceipts. Observation only: it is never banded or accepted without the required quality, capacity, and route/fallback evidence. Values are allowlisted and bounded; no transcript or model output is included.
signals.diagnostics: At most three inventory rows, never banded as outcome proof.
signals.evidence_integrity: Owner receipt count, valid/failed/invalid counts, and a typed reason. Failed attempts remain visible and are excluded from acceptance joins; malformed or identity-invalid receipts fail the structural audit. The typed proto default for an omitted empty repeated evidence field is zero receipts; a present non-list field is malformed. The raw evidence response is bounded at 1024 rows.
signals.acceptance_join: Required-row count, resolved-row count, distinct receipt cohorts, bounded inspected-receipt count, and aggregate in_band verdict from current owner receipt claims. Failed target-aware artifacts remain negative evidence even when their payload contains an optimistic claim.
signals.host_portability: A pass requires every declared D1 CPU, D1 accelerator, and constrained D2 cell with pinned Linux/amd64 OS and Chromium versions, host/model identity, same-artifact product-path evidence, and either passed inference with a compatible path or an explicit unavailable reason with visible fallback. Missing or extra cell keys fail closed; D3-D6 remain excluded.
signals.unavailable: Count of unknown outcome and diagnostic rows.
signals.experiment: Selection presence and ID, status, finished_at, acceptance_eligible=false, and evidence limitation; never recipe transcripts.
signals.replay_metrics: At most 16 cells containing engine_id, strategy, lane, diagnostic verdict, ref_words, WER, RTF and replay finalization p95; absent/invalid readings are null.

outputs.evidence: Successful governed binding IDs; no private payloads.

fixtures.note: A live read, not an audio qualification or a zero-unavailable gate. Partial is expected when the product API omits lab-only evidence; the output must retain the binding error and leave outcomes unknown.
Reject before bindings; no filesystem selector or transcript input.
